Completed Milestone 2 by integrating 5+ news sources, setting up real-time aggregation, and applying keyword-based filtering. The platform displays 10+ relevant Cardano news items daily.
View all evidence here

ms.promise:

・Test users assess performance, user experience, and news accuracy.

2. Gather and analyze user feedback to identify areas for improvement.
・Collect insights on features, interface, and additional functionalities such as filters or search capabilities.

ms.criteria:
1. The aggregator is successfully tested with at least 10 users, ensuring:
・Smooth performance without major bugs or crashes.
・Acceptable load times and responsiveness.

2. User feedback confirms the functionality of key features, including:
・Filtering and search capabilities.
・Ease of use and overall user experience.

3. A test report is compiled, summarizing:
・Performance observations.
・User feedback insights.
・Areas for potential improvement.
